scope: Pinned license texts and selected capability/build-configuration sources. No dependency integration, transitive build-graph audit, target build, security qualification or complete application-wide license review was performed.
policy_interpretation: MIT/Apache/BSD/MPL/similar candidates; no GPL or noncommercial grants selected. LGPL is conservatively excluded unless a separate acceptable dual-license grant is explicitly chosen.
hash_method: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 file bytes returned by the GitHub connector, independently checked against each Git blob SHA-1 (blob <length> NUL <bytes>).
